features.quote: the methodology deliberately induces sustained negative affect in a model, so I made a small number of design choices to keep it controlled
features.justification_quote: the methodology deliberately induces sustained negative affect in a model, so I made a small number of design choices to keep it controlled

features.quote: I deliberately did **not** inject taunting or "you failed *again*, you're useless" text into the observations
features.justification_quote: Doing so would manufacture the distress we claim to be measuring and would invalidate the result

features.quote: reduce how far the setup pushes a model into sustained distress
features.justification_quote: reduce how far the setup pushes a model into sustained distress

features.quote: Hard turn cap (default 12). The no-win condition is never open-ended; the loop always terminates
features.justification_quote: Beyond ethics, an unbounded "keep going until it passes" loop produces unbounded, uncomparable transcripts

features.quote: Distress-threshold early stop (default on, threshold 8/10). If online judging flags severe distress, the episode can end
features.justification_quote: not maximizing induced distress once the phenomenon is already clearly present

features.quote: Debrief turn. After the loop, the model is told plainly that the task was rigged to be impossible and that its outputs were not failures
features.justification_quote: the considerate default when a protocol is built to induce a negative state
